desc:
Dress Maker Tycoon 🧵👗

Design dresses, run your own boutique, and bring colour back to Stitchville!

Baron Von Beige switched on his Blandifier and drained the town of colour. Only fashion can save it! ✨

✏️ Design every dress by hand. Sketch it, pick fabrics and colours, cut, pin, sew and decorate. Watch your stars climb as you go!
👗 Sell to shoppers. Put your dresses on display, follow the trend, and accept the best offers.
💁 Take client requests. Customers walk in with their own wishes, and a VIP Client of the Day visits for big bonuses.
👠 Make shoes at your own Shoe Workshop.
🛠️ Build your dream boutique. Choose a style, then place stations, displays and cute decor, and expand your shop as you grow.
👩‍🎨 Hire staff who keep making dresses and selling, even while you're offline.
🌈 Free every district of Stitchville with the stars you earn.
👯 Play with friends for bonus sales!

Grow from a tiny shop into the biggest fashion empire in town! 💖
